source.publication: 2025 IT-140 Personal Income Tax Forms and Instructions (West Virginia Tax Division), with Schedule M bound in
source.section: Schedule M line 47 Senior Citizen Deduction columns (a)-(d) (PDF p.6; instructions PDF p.29; example PDF p.30; PDF p.23 'Taxpayers over age 65 or disabled'; Tax Division page: 'You receive the higher of the $8,000 modification or the sum of various itemized decreasing modifications'); Schedule M line 32 Military Retirement Modification (PDF p.5; instructions PDF p.28; PDF p.22 'Certain State and Federal Retirement Systems'); Schedule M line 34 Social Security Benefits, 100% at or under the AGI limit and 65% above it for 2025 (PDF p.5; instructions PDF p.28; PDF p.17; Tax Division Social Security Modification page); IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: The PDF p.30 example (John Doe 69, Mary Doe 65, joint, 13,000 of income each, federal AGI 26,000), on lines the projection models: John's 7,500 of lines 29 and 31 (police pension 7,000 and savings bond interest 500) is here 7,500 of military retirement on line 32, and Mary's 500 of savings bond interest on line 29 is here 500 of taxable Social Security on line 34. As in the example, John's column (d) is 7,500 and his line 47 is 500; Mary's column (d) is 500 and her line 47 is 7,500; each person's lines 29-34 plus line 47 come to 8,000. You (Column A) born 1956-07-01, age 69 at December 31, 2025; Spouse (Column B) born 1960-03-15, age 65 at December 31, 2025. Federal taxable Social Security (IRS worksheet, given): other income 25,500.00 + half of benefits 7,500.00 = provisional income 33,000.00; 50% x (33,000.00 - 32,000.00) = 500.00, limited to half the benefits 7,500.00: 500.00. Federal AGI (given) = military retirement 7,500.00 (you) + IRA distribution 5,500.00 (you) + wages 10,000.00 (spouse) + IRA distribution 2,500.00 (spouse) + taxable Social Security 500.00 = 26,000.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 26,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 - 2 x 1,600.00 aged 65 or older = -8,700.00, floored at 0.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 26,000.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M You (Column A): line 32 military retirement 7,500.00 (in full, no cap); line 47 (age 69): column (c) income not on lines 35-46 = 13,000.00, limited to 8,000.00: 8,000.00; column (d) lines 29-34 = 7,500.00; line 47 = 8,000.00 - 7,500.00 = 500.00; line 49 = 8,000.00. Schedule M Spouse (Column B): line 34(a) total benefits 15,000.00, (b) exempt for federal 14,500.00, (c) taxable 500.00; federal AGI 26,000.00 does not exceed 100,000.00, so line 34 = 500.00 (100%); line 47 (age 65): column (c) income not on lines 35-46 = 13,000.00, limited to 8,000.00: 8,000.00; column (d) lines 29-34 = 500.00; line 47 = 8,000.00 - 500.00 = 7,500.00; line 49 = 8,000.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 8,000.00 + 8,000.00 = 16,000.00. Projection (per person): You (Column A): Social Security subtraction 0.00; age 65 deduction = lesser of (8,000.00 - military retirement 7,500.00) and own income 13,000.00 = 500.00; best_of_group wv_line_47 keeps the larger, 500.00 (wv_senior_citizen_deduction); Spouse (Column B): Social Security subtraction 500.00; age 65 deduction = lesser of (8,000.00 - military retirement 0.00) and own income 13,000.00 = 8,000.00; best_of_group wv_line_47 keeps the larger, 8,000.00 (wv_senior_citizen_deduction). Projection subtractions total 16,000.00, the same as line 50. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 16,000.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 26,000.00 + 0.00 - 16,000.00 = 10,000.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 2 x 2,000.00 = 4,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 10,000.00 - 4,000.00 = 6,000.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule I (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 6,000.00 = 133.2; total 133.2 = 133.20. The Tax Table row 6,000 to under 6,100 (PDF p.38 on) gives 134; expected keeps the schedule formula on the exact income. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 133.20.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
